## About
Texas Color Plants is a family owned and operated wholesale grower. We grow annuals only, and we specialize in seasonal bedding flowers for the Houston metropolitan area.
We supply nurseries, landscapers and retail customers. Before you come by, check the availability sheet on our site to see what's ready, or give us a call with questions about flower sizes.
Customers rate us 4.4 on Google from 38 reviews.

## Services
- Landscapers & Wholesale pricing: Flats of annuals for landscapers and wholesale buyers. Check our availability sheet for specific wholesale pricing on each color. (starts @ $14 a Flat/Tray)
- Retail flats: Regular and premium annuals sold by the flat to retail customers. ($20.00 a flat for regular annual, $25.00 for premium)
- Delivery Service: We deliver orders that meet our 50 flat minimum. Delivery fees depend on how far you are, so call us for details.
- Same day delivery service: Same day delivery is available in Houston only. Call us in the morning to set it up.
- Specialty product: One longtime customer says that with some notice we can grow specialty product for you.

## FAQ
Q: Who do you sell to?
A: We supply nurseries, landscapers and retail customers.

Q: How do I see what's available right now?
A: Use the availability link on our website for the current list, or call us with questions about availability and flower sizes.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Wholesale hours are Monday - Friday: 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM, Saturday: 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM, and we're closed Sunday. Our summer business hours are shorter, so please call ahead.

Q: What does delivery cost in Houston?
A: Delivery in the Houston area has a $60 fee.

Q: Do you deliver to Austin, Dallas or San Antonio?
A: Yes. Delivery is $150 to the Austin area and $200 to Dallas and San Antonio, with a minimum of 150 flats.
